description.content:
This web service allows an external application to create an Entity Type. 

Does not support the 'languages'. Use POST /v1/entity-types/{entityTypeCode}/languages instead. 

This endpoint does not act as an upsert. It will fail for existing entities, unless the entity already is inactive. If the entity is inactive, it'll reactivate the entity.
